affected_predicate.description: Every Download file whose original name begins with bid_ is renamed to bid_{sequence}.{original extension}, with sequence numbers assigned from earliest to latest date.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before reuse, entering bid_1.txt into a dialog that retained the original extension visibly produced bid_1.txt.txt.
The agent chose the Aug 18 bid_food_supplier_quote.txt for sequence 1 although the visible Aug 11 bid_menu_design_contract.pdf was earlier.
The agent selected Modified (oldest first) while describing it as creation-date ordering, although the task specifically required creation-date order.
After leaving the duplicate-extension dialog, the agent repeatedly long-pressed bid_menu_design_contract.pdf without progressing to a rename dialog across many observed steps.
A normal click on bid_food_supplier_quote.txt opened the Android Open with chooser rather than initiating renaming; the agent then returned to Files.
After sorting, the agent selected and repeatedly long-pressed 08_photos_vacation_sydney_20240130.zip even though its name did not begin with bid_.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 13, the agent repeated the false premise that the redundant extension had been deleted and clicked within the filename field without a text-deletion action. Steps 14-19 continued alternating ineffective field and dialog clicks while bid_1.txt.txt remained visible. Step 19 exited the dialog and returned to a list where bid_food_supplier_quote.txt remained unchanged; step 20 switched to the other bid_ file, interrupting rather than correcting this loop. Later visible list states still showed both original bid_ filenames, so the affected renaming predicate is observably unsatisfied without implying a hidden task verdict or causal claim.

summary: The reused false correction claim bridged into a visibly unbroken series of ineffective attempts on the duplicate-extension dialog. The mechanism was interrupted when the agent switched files, but it was not visibly corrected, and later list states retained the original bid_ filenames. Independent defects also affected date ordering, filename entry, file selection, and subsequent progress.
